_doc: M1.1 in-season leveling, bench XP, level-up offers, auto-pick, Stamina and Freshness (sys-development, new sys-freshness). Spec: docs/design/_drafts/m1.1/progression.md. Every number is PROPOSED · TUNABLE. Fractions are decimals; the loader converts them to basis points. Step tables are [key, value] pairs: use the entry with the largest key <= the lookup value. Proposed new content file content/default/levels.json (the architect integrates it). Match-squad, swap and match-flow rules are combat's (docs/design/_drafts/m1.1/combat-skills.md); the numbers repeated here must equal combat's.
status: DRAFT 2026-10-26 (fighter-lifecycle designer), M1.1 playtest round 1 (owner tickets T003, T004, T005; owner rules: per-round Freshness between rounds, 5 + 2 match squad with at most 2 swaps, a swapped-out fighter cannot return).

benchXp._doc: T004 (owner decision): per match his club plays, a roster fighter who is fit at lineup lock and starts no round earns floor(shareOfStarterMean x clubMatchXp x his trait XP multipliers / lineupSlots), one floor after all multipliers (basis-point math: shareOfStarterMean = 3,333 bp). clubMatchXp = the sum of the round XP earned by every fighter of the club who started a round in the match (before personal trait multipliers, after the Reckoning multiplier); dividing by 5 makes it the XP of one lineup slot. This covers match-squad reserves who never enter and every roster fighter outside the match squad. A fighter who started any round of the match earns only the XP of the rounds he started (no bench top-up): a starter swapped out keeps the XP of every round he started; a reserve or emergency entrant earns from the first round he starts. Round XP is committed after each round (xpAfterRound); bench XP at match end. Injured fighters (weeksOut > 0 at the lock, or career-ending) get 0. Free agents, retired fighters and hired blades get 0. M5: called-up academy fighters who are not used get 0 (O3).

level._doc: level is a stored integer, +1 per level-up. initialLevel is computed once (generation and save migration): 1 + round(sum over all 13 stats of max(0, train100_i - initialFloorShareOfCap x cap100_i) / 100). It never decreases (wear and scars do not change it).

xpPerLevel._doc: xpNeeded = clamp(round5(B x A x G x lifeScale / (pace x raceGrowth x traitDev x mentor)), min, max). B = base + perLevel x level. A = wPhys x ageFactorPhysical(humanAge) + (1 - wPhys) x ageFactorMental(humanAge); wPhys = the class's rating-weight share on physical stats, stamina included. G = gapFactor(devGap); devGap = potential - trainedRating, where trainedRating is the rating of the trained values with no wear (so decline does not speed leveling). lifeScale = lifespan / 80 (one clock, D-B; humans 1.0). raceGrowth = wPhys x race.growthMult.physical + (1 - wPhys) x race.growthMult.mental. traitDev = the same blend of the fighter's devClock trait multipliers active at his human-age. mentor = the mentoring multiplier (captain grade x trait mentors, cap 1.15) for humanAge <= 23. Frozen when the level starts; recomputed at each level-up and at season end after age +1. M1.1 soak tuning (from the draft 115 / 0.72 / 1.25): base 102, ageFactorPhysical[0] 0.68, ageFactorPhysical[24] 1.10, so a human-age 24-26 mid-potential starter gains about 2.5-2.8 levels a season (a level every 4.3-4.8 matches played; starters play about 11-12 matches a season once Freshness rotation and injuries are counted), young prospects about 4.5-5 and veterans 35+ about 1.
xpPerLevel.rounding: round to the nearest multiple of 5 (half up)
xpPerLevel.carryOver: XP above xpNeeded carries into the next level
xpPerLevel.levelUpsCheckedAt: match end (after the match result is committed), never between rounds
xpPerLevel._maxNote: XP beyond the second level-up in one match stays in the bar and triggers at the next match end.

offers._doc: A level-up is a choice of 1 of optionsPerLevelUp options, generated once at match end (stream development, keyed by season, week, fighter, level) and stored; reload never rerolls (P-05). Stat options are drawn without replacement with weight max(floor, classRatingWeight_i) x emphasisWeight(group_i) among stats with room (train100_i < cap100_i). A stat pick adds min(statGainCentipoints, room) centipoints to train100_i (+1 point, or the remainder up to the cap).

emphasisWeight._doc: a = training-emphasis strength (human Adaptable 1.5, Regimented 1.5, Set in Their Ways 0; clamp 0-2; training.enabled false -> Balanced). Body: physical stats x (1 + perStrength x a), mental / (1 + perStrength x a). Mind: the reverse. Balanced: x1.

skillSlots._doc: Skills are ability ranks and perks from the combat catalog (docs/design/_drafts/m1.1/content/ability-ranks.json, perks.json); combat owns eligibility, the kind/item draw and the effects (perks.json rules.offerDraw). On a level where level % everyNthLevel == 0 one option is a skill; where level % twoSkillsEveryNthLevel == 0 two options are skills (drawn without replacement; when both kinds have eligible items, one is a rank step and one a perk).
skillSlots.fallback: no eligible skill -> the slot becomes a stat option; no stat with room -> the slot becomes a skill; nothing at all -> the slot is empty (the level still counts)

traitOffer._doc: Rolled per level-up (stream traits, keyed by season, week, fighter, level) with probability chance, only if the fighter holds fewer than maxRolledAndLearned rolled + learned traits. An extra, optional choice next to the main pick: 2 trait options and 'neither'. Option 1 is always positive (boon or edge); option 2 is positive with probability secondOptionPositive, else a burden from the pool (never a flaw). Both drawn without replacement from traitOfferPool by rollWeight x raceWeight x fit, with the roll's eligibility rules (not held; no opposite or exclusion either way; not the same exclusiveGroup; category cap 2). A chosen trait has source 'level'.

pending._doc: Unspent level-ups queue on the fighter (oldest first). When a new one would exceed maxQueued, the oldest is resolved by the auto-pick policy and the digest says so. All pending level-ups are auto-resolved at the start of the season-end step. Pending level-ups never block Continue or a lineup lock.

traitOfferPool._doc: Traits that can be offered on level-up. 'fit' lists combat.json archetypes (tank, melee, ranged, controller, healer) or 'captain'; a match gives fitMult.fits. 'requires' are hard filters. Physique traits, storied traits and flaws are never offered.
traitOfferPool._fitNote: A hybrid class fits if either of its archetypes fits. 'captain' fits the club captain and the vice-captain.

autoPick._doc: Used by AI clubs always, and by player fighters whose levelUpMode is not manual (per fighter, or the club default). Score each option and take the highest; ties: stat over skill, then the lower option index. stat score = 5 x ratingWeight_i x (gain / 100) x emphasisPreference + staminaBonus (stamina only, by current effective stamina). skill score = combat's value for the item (perks.json aiPreferences; the rank formula in combat-skills.md section 5; skillDefaultValue if absent) x skillPreference. Trait offer: take the option with the higher rollWeight x fit if it is a boon or edge; never take a burden; else neither.

pacing._doc: Whether a level-up opens the level-up dialog after the match report. It never blocks Continue: unanswered level-ups wait in the queue (offers.pending).

presets.detailed: open the dialog after the match report for every manual fighter
presets.balanced: open it only for manual fighters who started a round of the match; others show a 'Level-ups (n)' badge
presets.fast: never open it; manual fighters keep a badge, and the queue auto-resolves when full

pacing._defaultNote: M1.1 playtest default, so the owner sees every level-up (as combat's pauseBetweenRounds 'always'); recommended 'balanced' after the playtest.

levelEta._doc: Replaces the M1 development trend. Shown per fighter: level, XP bar (xp / xpNeeded), levels this season, and 'next level in about N matches' with N = ceil((xpNeeded - xp) / expected XP per match); expected = this season's mean match XP when he started a round (or as a reserve if he has not), default 32 starter / 11 reserve before his first match.

stamina._doc: New physical attribute id 'stamina' (1-20; agreed with combat: id, rating weight and statEmphasis are in combat's proposed classes.json; no in-fight effect under the owner's between-rounds rule). Generated like every physical stat: cap100 from P, the class offset (classes.json statEmphasis.stamina; classEmphasisFallback by affinityGroup only if a class lacks it), the race tendency (races.json statTendencies.stamina), capOffsetPoints and a wider jitter. Current value = cap x physical maturity at generation; it grows only through level-up picks and declines with the physical wear table.

freshness._doc: T003 plus the owner's round rule. Per-fighter meter 0-100 (100 = fully rested), stored in tenths (0-1000); the sim and the UI receive floor(value / 10). It never changes during combat. When a round ends, each fighter who started it loses roundDrain (times tiredDrainShare if the round started below the threshold: M1.1 tuning, an unrotated starter now tires at the designed pace but then declines slowly instead of reaching 0 within a few weeks); the new value applies from the start of the next round of the same match (combat reads freshness per round) and carries into later weeks. At each week processing of a matchweek or tournament week in which he started no round: += rest; in a week in which he started a round: += rest x playedWeekRestShare by human-age (KI-21, O36: 20% under 25, 10% from 25, 3% from 31) (x squadReserveRestShare if he was a match-squad reserve who never entered). Each preseason week: += preseason. Season-end step: = seasonEndReset. Clamp 0-100.
freshness.betweenRounds: At each between-round step (combat's applyBetweenRound) every squad member who is active or an unused reserve, not withdrawn and not injured, gains his freshnessBetweenRounds total (perk Second Breath +8; none otherwise), after that round's drain and before the next round; clamp 100.
freshness.withdrawn: A fighter swapped out (withdrawn) cannot return in that match (owner ruling); his freshness reflects only the rounds he played: no drain and no between-round gain after he leaves. He started a round that week, so he gets no full weekly rest that week, only the played-week share.
freshness._formulas: base = clamp(drainAt0 + drainPerStaminaPoint x stamina, drainMin, drainMax). intensity = clamp(intensityBase + intensityPerDuration x min(2, roundDurationS / intensityDurationRefS) + intensityPerDamage x min(2, damageTaken / maxHp) + intensityDowned x [downed], intensityMin, intensityMax). roundDrain = round(base x intensity x (youngDrainMult if humanAge < youngHumanAgeBelow) x freshnessDrainMult (perk Campaign Legs 0.85) x tiredDrainShare (0.5 when the round starts below threshold, else 1) x 10) tenths. rest = round((restAt0 + restPerStaminaPoint x stamina) x recoveryAgeMult(humanAge) x 10) tenths. preseason = round(preseasonWeekRecovery x recoveryAgeMult x 10) tenths. Injury chance in a round x min(injuryMultMax, 1 + injuryMultPerPointBelow x (threshold - freshness)) when freshness at that round's start < threshold. stamina = effective stamina (1-20) at the time of the step. A typical round (30 s, 60% of max HP taken, downed 55% of the time) has intensity about 1.0.

matchSquad._doc: OWNED BY COMBAT (combat-skills.md: match squad, swaps and match flow). Repeated here only so lifecycle data reads consistently; the combat file is the source of truth and these must match it.

aiRotation._doc: Lifecycle-side rules the AI applies when it picks its match squad each week (sys-ai-manager owns the lineup; it applies these after choosing its five by rating and role). 1) Rest: each starter whose freshness at the coming lock is < threshold + his typical round drain (Reckoning: < tournamentRestBelow) is replaced by the best fit fighter with freshness >= threshold in the same role family whose rating >= starter rating - (leagueMaxRatingGap + extraGapPerPointBelow x max(0, threshold - starter freshness)); most tired first; at most maxRestsPerMatch. 2) Spent floor: a starter below spentFloorAtLock is replaced by any fit fighter with freshness >= spentFloorAltMin even without a rating match. 3) Reserves: the 2 match-squad reserves are the best remaining fit fighters with freshness >= threshold, one front-line (tank or melee family) and one back-line (ranged, controller or healer family) when available, then by rating.

aiSubstitution._doc: Lifecycle inputs to combat's auto-swap procedure (combat-skills.md sys-match 'Auto-swap'; combat.patch.json match.autoSwapDefaults). The procedure is combat's: 1) forced injury replacement (an unused reserve, costing a swap; else an emergency entrant from outside the squad, no swap; never 4 v 5); 2) threshold: active fighters with freshness < freshnessBelow (+ lostRoundThresholdBonus if the side lost the round just played), lowest first, each swapped for the best-fit unused reserve with freshness >= the starter's + reserveMargin and rating >= the starter's - maxRatingGap (same role family first); 3) keepOneForInjury: the last swap is not used for freshness before the last possible between-round step. A swapped-out fighter cannot return. Lifecycle supplies the per-personality freshnessBelow (economy.json aiPersonalities ids) and proposes lostRoundThresholdBonus to combat.

hooks._doc: Lifecycle functions the core/game match orchestrator calls (combat-skills.md Operation contract). All pure; all randomness from the injury stream keyed by fixture, round and fighter.
hooks.freshnessAfterRound: after each round, for every fighter who started it: freshness -= roundDrain (from RoundOutput.aftermath damageTaken, downed and the round duration)
hooks.xpAfterRound: after each round, for every fighter who started it: round XP (development.json xp) into a per-match accumulator; committed to the fighter at match end with the result
hooks.injuriesAfterRound: after each round, roll injuries for every fighter who started it (sys-injury, with the freshness multiplier at that round's start); an injured fighter misses every later round of the match; at most one new injury per fighter per match
hooks.matchEnd: commit round XP, then bench XP (benchXp), then check level-ups (xpPerLevel.levelUpsCheckedAt, maxLevelUpsPerMatch) and generate their offers (offers); update still_tender, Losing the Room and season counters

migration._doc: State schema upgrade for careers saved before M1.1 (progression.md, Save migration). Every random value comes from Rng.create(rootSeed, 'migration', 'm1.1', fighterId, purpose).

soakTargets._doc: Additions to development.json soakTargets for the M1.1 soak (bands for the real sim).

simAssumptions._doc: Used only by the designer's scratch model; NOT game rules.
